title: Search prospect for electrophilic bosons at the $μ$TRISTAN
summary: Mediators coupled predominantly to the electron remain weakly constrained above the kinematic reach of the $B$~factories, a region that is difficult to access at hadron colliders and only partially covered by existing $e^+e^-$ data. We point out that the asymmetric $μ^+e^-$ mode of the proposed $μ$TRISTAN collider, operating at $\sqrt{s}=346$~GeV, is well suited to this window, and quantify its reach for two minimal realisations: an axion-like particle and a $Z'$ gauge boson, treated as effective interactions with the electron current.
